taxon.wikipedia_summary: Schoenoplectus pungens is a species of flowering plant in the sedge family known by the common names common threesquare, common three-square bulrush and sharp club-rush. It is a herbaceous emergent plant that is widespread across much of North and South America as well as Europe, New Zealand and Australia.
